description: So I asked, "What is on your heart and mind at the federal level of government?" They responded, "Nothing, really." I got specific. "How are you doing with the price of gas these days?" Ladies: Fine Me: Really? It's kind of high right now. That can be hard on people, especially those with fixed incomes.…
